observations.B01: First word has a strongly retraced initial d but following iagramme is readable. Déterminé has a raised final accent; isom. is visibly abbreviated before unique. Lower adjacent-line ascenders excluded.
observations.B02: Près, en se donnant un ordre total sur is legible. The two tall t strokes in total are separated by low connecting letters. Upper descenders and lower insertion tips excluded.
observations.B03: Parenthetical défini is above an insertion curve before mod. The long crossed word tentatively reads interversion, replaced by transposition written above. After deux premiers there appear two separate et groups with a comma between, retained without smoothing. Upper près fragment and lower next-line tips excluded.
observations.B04: Définissent is tentatively readable, but its final letters are heavily inked and may include a correction. Following short word is crossed out, with surviving humps supporting un or une. Upper punctuation fragment excluded.
observations.B05: M is unhatted, with infinity exponent and indices 0,nu. Rightmost une is clipped at the box edge. A literal two-stroke equality mark precedes composante connexe. Suffit de is inserted above montrer with a long joining curve. Final line reads deux ordres totaux déduits l’un de. Upper fragments of the preceding line are excluded.
observations.B06: Transposition de deux and consécutifs are clear; the abbreviated noun at line start is compressed and retained as élts/élmts. Raised c_i,c_{i+1} has a dense epsilon-like mark immediately to its left; its identity or possible cancellation is unresolved. A literal equality mark again precedes composante. Upper previous-line fragment and lower next-line tips excluded.
observations.B07: Connexe. Or on le voit en notant que is legible. Cropped upper consécutifs descender and lower ascenders excluded.
observations.B08: Initial tiny mark resembles 2 but could be a very reduced les; kept uncertain. Deux morphismes de spécialisation is readable. Upper prior-line fragments excluded.
observations.B09: Dans is written above a crossed de; both are retained with replacement boundaries.
observations.B10: Chain drawing has filled vertices; labels from left are (c1,c2), c3, c_{i-1}, (c_i,c_{i+1}), c_{i+2}, and c_nu after an ellipsis. Separate C/c-like label is below the first vertex, with case uncertain. Horizontal strokes are edges, without arrowheads.
observations.B11: Pro- and -viennent connect in a long low stroke; read proviennent de. No punctuation is visible.
observations.B12: Four filled vertices with labels c_{i-1}, c_i, c_{i+1}, c_{i+2}, and continuation dots at both ends. Small stray dot below the first vertex has no label-like shape and is excluded.
observations.B13: Same four-vertex chain, with middle labels visibly reversed: c_{i-1}, c_{i+1}, c_i, c_{i+2}. Dotted continuation at both ends.
observations.B14: En contractant la is readable. A short canceled word has a large g-like descender and tentatively reads seg; arête is raised above as replacement. Qui joint c_i et c_{i+1} follows, then comma and OK. with capital K cross-strokes.
observations.B15: Pencil foliation reads 74, with the crossbar of 7 and open angular lower part of 4.
